description: Abstract base class for live commands that wrap ThingModifyCommand objects in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides common functionality for commands that modify 'things' in the system, including retrieving the entity ID and entity data.

classes.name: AbstractModifyLiveCommand
classes.description: An abstract class providing base implementation for live commands that modify things, wrapping a ThingModifyCommand.

methods.name: AbstractModifyLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a ThingModifyCommand instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing entity associated with the command.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity data for the specified JSON schema version, if available.
